name: The Saga Vault
overview: The Saga Vault is a reality competition series hosted by prop expert Dan Lanigan that unites the world’s most elite Star Wars super collectors to help curate the upcoming Saga Museum. In each themed episode, passionate film historians pitch the crown jewels of their private Star Wars archives, ranging from screen used film props to rare prototype toys, leaving it up to the audience to vote on which legendary artifact earns a permanent spot inside the physical vault.
